name: Innovaero Technologies Ltd.
summary: Innovaero Technologies Limited, formerly Aerovation Technologies Pty Ltd, designs, develops, manufactures and commercialises aircraft products and drones in Australia. It supplies uncrewed aerial systems, including loitering munitions and one-way effectors, and a crewed aircraft product, serving defence, aerospace and related industrial markets. Founded in 2006, it is based in Kardinya.
